visual_direction.rule: Every primary character must remain identifiable by silhouette plus at least six distinct axes among face geometry, age, body build, helmet, wardrobe, prop, posture and expression before reading a name label.
forbidden: real company logos or project names other than NEW PSI
random pseudo text on helmets; only the NEW PSI mark is allowed
visual_direction.allowed_company_mark: NEW PSI only; small, clean, readable fictional project/company mark
